theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (ζ : Euclid P → MultiVector P (n + 1)) (g : Euclid P → Euclid P), StronglyMeasurable ζ → Measurable g → ∃ ζ' : Euclid P → MultiVector P n, StronglyMeasurable ζ' ∧ (∀ x (α : Covector (Euclid P) n), ζ' x α = ζ x (ContinuousAlternatingMap.alternatizeUncurryFin ((innerSL ℝ (‖g x‖⁻¹ • g x)).smulRight α))) ∧ (∀ x (α : Covector (Euclid P) n), ‖g x‖ * ζ' x α = ζ x (ContinuousAlternatingMap.alternatizeUncurryFin ((innerSL ℝ (g x)).smulRight α))) ∧ ∀ x (α : Covector (Euclid P) n), |ζ x (ContinuousAlternatingMap.alternatizeUncurryFin ((innerSL ℝ (g x)).smulRight α))| ≤ ((n : ℝ) + 1) * ‖ζ x‖ * ‖g x‖ * ‖α‖
